You can use:

To get better speed and generate image with 10 steps
-Wan2.1 T2V 14B FusionX LoRA.safetensors
To get better speed and generate image with 10 steps + beautiful style

---->WHEN USING THE WAN 14B T2V FusionX model
You can use:
-The model itself alone for a nice style and 10 steps speed
-The other loras as well for a different style (more saturation and contrast)
->Activate VACE GRAIN to enable film grain to add more realism
->Activate VACE MAG for an increased speed (small quality hit)

---->Activate the image resize IMG2IMG RESIZE
to enter a specific image resolution or leave it disabled to get the automatic original resolution from below
->Activate IMG2IMG GRAIN to enable film grain to add more realism
->Activate IMG2IMG MAG for an increased speed (small quality hit)
->Activate TXT MAG for an increased speed (small quality hit)
->Activate TXT GRAIN to enable film grain to add more realism
